notes.title: Hoomans!! We bring updates!!
notes.content:
Greetings Hoomans! We've been hard at work and brought some improvements to the game.

Gather round, gather round!

Firstly, aiming is no longer inverted from the get-go. This decision was made based on a bunch of research and testing and resulted in the majority of peasants preferring it so. [b]Don't fret[/b], for you still have the option to invert your controls from the settings screen.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2zqOy4D.png[/img]

Secondly, we added an Accelerometer!! We had to use a time machine to bring it back to medieval times!! This little guy helps show you how much power/velocity you're putting into your fling and will appear whenever you start aiming, nifty!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MyqPFUi.png[/img]

Lastly, cancelling aims can't get more entertaining than this! We first implemented the ability to cancel your aim with a right click, then we added a fart. Later we discovered a bug where a right click allows you to fart on command, it's since been flagged as a feature! Get ready to fly your kite, cause it's about to get windy!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ci8WbmH.png[/img]

[b]Detailed Updates[/b]

[list]
[*] Aiming depth fixed, it now shows over all objects except the darker foreground
[*] Veloshity spelling mistake now reads Veloshitty, not that it's a real word, but hey!
[*] Going from a level to outfits and back now takes you straight to the level
[*] Controls are no longer inverted by default, but can still be changed from the settings screen
[*] Tutorial has been improved
[*] Level 7's difficulty has been decreased
[*] Hints now have improved visibility when viewed with brighter colours
[*] Cosmetics will no longer clip through the bucket
[*] Added Accelerometer
[*] Added Announements Feature
[*] Game Camera has been centered
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for 5 December (v1.001)
notes.content:
First of all, a big thanks to everyone who has been playing the game and supporting us! We're super thankful!

We've addressed some UX issues as well as a few bug fixes, details below;

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Sir Sticks-A-Lot typo fixed in book of poo to read kale instead of khale
[*] Level 20 had a water bucket glitch which caused the water to appear above the water, this has been fixed
[*] The main menu text for playing always showed "Continue" even when a new game was started, this has been fixed
[/list]
[b]UX Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] A new achievement when scoring 3 golden toilet rolls has been added along with a new sound fx
[*] Level 12 Tutorial text now no longer re-appears all the time when retrying
[*] Rats and Bats now don't stray too far from points of interest and will make it easier to hit and score 3 golden toilet rolls
[/list]
Thank you for your patience and continued support, any new issues that we pick up will be looked into ASAP.

Happy Pooping Hoomans!

notes.title: Launch Date Moved Ahead!! :D
notes.content:

We’ve been hard at work smashing bugs, finalising end-game content, and polishing like there’s no tomorrow, ALSO we have been working on some holiday-themed content which will be available at launch!
